summary: Spell-cast shout in the 3.82 font and colour
author: pm
body:
Spell-cast shout follows 3.82, not our version. User, 2026-11-25: "Follow the original 3.82 version not ours."

3.82 (DrawChatMsgBox, message types 41/42, line 20898+ of the 3.82 bundle Game.cpp): the name is drawn with PutString (the default font) at RGB(180, 30, 30), twice, 1 px apart in x, with no shadow, centred on the legacy width estimate.

Ours drew it with sprite font 003 (SprFont3_0) in Red4x, with a two-point shadow and additive blend (floating_text_manager.cpp:293-306, as of 2026-11-25).

Fix (guard f1428493):
- floating_text_types.h: magic_cast_name now uses the renderer path, colour UISpellNameRed.
- floating_text_manager.cpp: a 3.82-style branch in the renderer path.
- common_types.h: adds UISpellNameRed.

Not compiled yet: the tree currently has another agent's in-progress engine edits (HH-0083) that do not build. Compile after that lands.

**Done when:** spell names draw in the default font in dark red, doubled; both builds are clean; a screenshot of a cast is attached.

**Verified, 2026-11-25:** review PASS (two rounds); Windows Debug and Linux client builds clean. Not yet seen in game (needs a caster in view).
